snippet.description:
When should you start preparing for UPSC Prelims 2027? Santosh Sir shares his honest advice on balancing UPSC Mains and Prelims preparation, and when to shift your focus to Prelims.

For most aspirants, prioritising Mains until December and beginning focused Prelims preparation in January can be a practical approach. However, if you feel confident about Mains but need more time for Prelims, starting earlier may help.

The Prelims Master Program 2027 by LevelUp IAS is designed to help aspirants prepare with a structured system of GS and CSAT classes, current affairs updates, practice tests and mentorship.

#PrelimsMasterProgram #UPSC2027 #UPSCPrelims2027 #UPSCPreparation #UPSCStrategy #SantoshSir #LevelUpIAS
